Reference Text: Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city. They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses. The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family. message.content:
Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became fascinated by mortal cities.
They loved the nicely paved ground in every street.
They admired the intricate bridges over the water.
Most of all, they loved the houses.
The stone walls were nicely laid out.
Those walls formed shelters from the weather.
Yet the walls still connected the earth to family stories.
Pebble Spring decided to learn housebuilding.
They hoped to add a touch of arcane magic.
Their self-made staff hummed with quiet power.
The staff helped shape small stones with care.
Pebble Spring watched the mortals work daily.
They copied the angles of doorways and roofs.
The town folk smiled at the careful Leshy.
Pebble Spring carried moss and clay together.
They practiced making a tiny hut in the woods.
The hut leaked when the rain returned.
Pebble Spring studied the joints with patience.
They learned that mortar needed steady hands.
The second hut stood through the first storm.
The third hut had a neat hearth.
Pebble Spring felt proud of the warm room.
They promised to build shelters for lonely travelers.
In the morning Pebble Spring built a small shelter for a weary traveler and painted the stone walls with tiny leaves and flowers so the guest would see a cheerful design made from some spotty patterns.
